environment.limits: Single uncontrolled desktop host; OS filesystem cache is not flushed. Cold means empty tool disk cache, not cold OS/page cache. No simultaneous benchmark suites. No production CDN, Next.js or serverless measurement.

protocol: Seven rotated/reversed fresh-Node rounds per corpus/configuration, each cold deletes tool caches and immediately repeats warm in a fresh process. OS cache unflushed, serial suites, no concurrent heavy checks. Explicit 288/384/480px WebP q75 fitinside no preview; competitors quality75. Identical sorted asset byte/SHA multisets required across all rounds/configurations/tools. buildMs includes tool import, common Vite/Svelte imports outside timer; processWallMs includes startup and verification; process peak RSS includes workers. Baseline study uses explicit workers1/2/4 in frozen3.1.3; comparisons use tool native defaults.
